'''Augmented spin barrels''' were a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] or [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifle]] modification available for 1750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The barrel increased the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] penetration and damage output of a weapon using [[Upgraded galven pattern|updated and streamlined galven pattern]] and heavy duty static pulse adaptors. The downside to using the barrel was increased maintenance and downtime for the weapon due to a greater amount of stress placed on both the frame and barrel. Examples of augmented spin barrels that were available included [[Dolmax/Legends|Dolmax's]] [[234X augmented spin barrel]], [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]' [[HH780 HotShot barrel]] and [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[Model 213 Perforator barrel]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Augmented spin barrels were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
